releases.note: Preserves all smoke checks across three fresh starts. Streams local file bodies without allocating them per client, tightens request and chunk framing, and prevents reuse of pre-reload upstream connections. A diagnostic 4096-client large-file comparison had higher median throughput but failures in both candidates, so it is inconclusive.
